records.literal_gloss: Give thanks to YHWH, for [he is] good, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: Give thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for [{{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is] good, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: Give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} thanks, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is good; {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: Thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is good! His faithful love lasts forever.

fr.L: Rendez grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, car [{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est] bon, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.

fr.R: Remerciez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est bon ! Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

decisions.choice: loyal love: faithful, covenant love
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith within a bond, here the LORD's love for his people. Literal and Balanced say "loyal love", Readable "faithful love".

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: Every one of the 26 verses ends with the same words (ki le'olam chasdo), "for his loyal love [is] forever": the people's answer to each line. The refrain is rendered the same way in every verse at each level.

decisions.choice: a call heard throughout Israel's worship
decisions.reason: The opening line and the refrain are also 106:1, 107:1 and 118:1, and were sung at the ark's coming to Jerusalem (1 Chronicles 16:34), at the temple's dedication (2 Chronicles 7:3) and at the laying of the second temple's foundation (Ezra 3:11).

decisions.choice: a litany of God's acts
decisions.reason: The psalm gives thanks for creation (verses 4-9), the exodus (10-16), the gift of the land (17-22) and God's care now (23-25). Later Jewish tradition calls it the Great Hallel. It retells what 135:8-12 tells more briefly.

decisions.choice: Thank
decisions.reason: Readable says "thank" in the call that runs through the psalm (verses 1-3, 26).

decisions.choice: the refrain: "car son amour loyal [est] pour toujours" (Literal); "car son amour fidèle dure toujours" (Balanced); "Son amour fidèle dure toujours." (Readable)
decisions.reason: The terms note sets this refrain for Psalms 106, 107, 118 and 136, so that it reads the same wherever it comes. Readable makes it a sentence of its own, as the English Readable does; at the start of a sentence "Son" is capitalised either way, so it carries no setting there.

decisions.choice: "Remerciez" at Readable; "Rendez grâce" at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: The terms note sets "rendre grâce" for hodu; Readable uses the everyday word, as the English Readable says "Thank".

decisions.choice: The refrain: "kwa maana upendo wake usiokoma [ni] wa milele" (L); "kwa maana upendo wake usiokoma unadumu milele" (B); "Upendo wake usiokoma unadumu milele" as a sentence of its own (R)
alternatives: "kwa kuwa fadhili zake ni za milele"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew refrain has no verb: "for his loyal love [is] forever". Literal shows that with a bracket; Balanced and Readable say that it lasts ("unadumu"). The same words are used in all twenty-six verses, as the Hebrew repeats itself, and in the other psalms that have this refrain. "Mshukuruni" (give thanks, plural) is the Hebrew hodu.

decisions.choice: "porque su amor leal [es] para siempre" (L); "porque su amor fiel dura para siempre" (B); "Su amor fiel dura para siempre." (R)
alternatives: porque para siempre es su misericordia
decisions.reason: The refrain closes all 26 verses and is rendered the same way in each, as the meaning decision asks. Literal keeps the Hebrew's lack of a verb in brackets; Balanced and Readable say "dura". Readable, like the English Readable, makes the refrain its own sentence.

decisions.choice: plural_you on "Den gracias" (L, B) and "Denle gracias" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew call "give thanks" is plural, spoken to the gathered people; Spanish marks it with the plural_you setting here and in verses 2, 3 and 26.

decisions.choice: the refrain: "vì tình yêu thương thành tín của Ngài [là] đời đời" (L); "... còn đến đời đời" (B); "Tình thương không hề thay đổi của Ngài còn đến đời đời" (R)
alternatives: "vì sự nhân từ Ngài còn đến đời đời"
decisions.reason: The refrain repeats in every verse of the psalm. It takes the wording the terms note fixes for it, with the words for loyal love from the published Psalm 23:6, and Readable makes it a sentence of its own, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "Hãy cảm tạ" for "give thanks" at every level
decisions.reason: As in the published Psalm 139:14, "cảm tạ" is the respectful word for thanking God; "cảm ơn" would sound casual even at Readable.

decisions.choice: The refrain is "참으로 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다" (L), "그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다" (B), "그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다" (R) in all 26 verses
alternatives: the refrain joined to each line as a clause of reason
decisions.reason: As the terms note, so that the refrain reads alike in Psalms 106, 107, 118 and 136. Each verse ends with the refrain as a sentence of its own; Literal gives the Hebrew "for" (ki) as "참으로" (indeed), since a Korean clause of reason would have to end the line with "-기 때문이다" twenty-six times.

decisions.choice: "감사하여라" for the call "Give thanks"
decisions.reason: "감사하다" is the terms note's word for hodu; the plain imperative is the voice of the call to worship in this block.

decisions.choice: Rendam graças ao SENHOR, porque ele é bom; o seu amor leal dura para sempre (B), the refrain as 1 Chronicles 16:34
alternatives: o seu amor fiel dura para sempre (R)
pois a sua misericórdia dura para sempre
decisions.reason: The refrain (m2, m3) has the words of 1 Chronicles 16:34 and Psalm 107:1 at each level, and is repeated identically in all 26 verses: "porque o seu amor leal [é] para sempre" (L), "o seu amor leal dura para sempre" (B, R). Readable keeps "amor leal" in this refrain, as Chronicles and Psalm 107 do, although the Psalms elsewhere say "amor fiel" at Readable, so that the people's answer reads the same at every level and in every book. "Rendam graças" (L, B) and "Agradeçam" (R) carry the call through verses 1-3 and 26.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Psalm 136.
alternatives: spans like the English ones (from verse 1)
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic.

decisions.choice: the refrain as Ezra 3:11 and 1 Chronicles 16:34 on main, identical in all 26 verses: Literal «… ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ነውና።», Balanced and Readable «… ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።»; verse 1 is 1 Chronicles 16:34 level by level
alternatives: varying the refrain with the English Readable
decisions.reason: The terms list settles the refrain on the Ezra and Chronicles wording, and a litany keeps one response throughout; ḥesed is "ጽኑ ፍቅር" (meaning decision m1). The Readable full stop before the refrain follows the English Readable's two sentences.

decisions.choice: the Hindi of 1 Chronicles 16:34 at each level, without its line break
decisions.reason: The verse is the call of 1 Chronicles 16:34 (meaning m3), and the poetry note has the refrain copied from it. Each level keeps that wording; the English here has no line break, so neither does the Hindi.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi; God spoken of takes the honorific plural ("वे", "उनका") through the psalm.

decisions.choice: the wording of 1 Chronicles 16:34
decisions.reason: The verse is the call of 1 Chronicles 16:34 word for word in the Hebrew (m3), so each level copies its Russian there (without the line break, as the English here has none). Its second half is the refrain of all 26 verses (m2) and keeps one wording per level: «потому что вовек неизменная любовь его» (L), «его неизменная любовь длится вечно» (B, R). Hesed is неизменная любовь at every level, as the poetry note settles for the LORD's love.

decisions.choice: The refrain hodu laYHWH ki-tov ki le'olam chasdo word for word as 1 Chronicles 16:34, 106:1 and 107:1; ki le'olam chasdo in all 26 verses identical: "その誠実はとこしえに[続く]からである。" (L), "その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く。" (B), "その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled refrain form (1CH-consistency, PSA-1); the litany repeats it after every line (m2, m4), so the Japanese repeats it unchanged. L keeps からである in every verse because each verse has ki; the English is prose here, so no \q.

decisions.choice: The refrain keeps the wording set in Psalm 118: "бо його незмінна любов — навіки" (L), "бо його незмінна любов триває навіки" (B), "Його вірна любов триває вічно" (R), unchanged through all 26 verses
decisions.reason: The refrain is a sung response the people repeat; one wording per level lets it sound the same each time, as in the Hebrew.

records.literal_gloss: Give thanks to [the] God of the gods, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: Give thanks to the God of the gods, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: Give thanks to the God of gods, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: Thank the God who is greater than all gods. His faithful love lasts forever.

fr.L: Rendez grâce au Dieu des dieux, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.
fr.B: Rendez grâce au Dieu des dieux, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Remerciez le Dieu qui est plus grand que tous les dieux. Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.R: Mshukuruni Mungu aliye mkuu kuliko miungu yote. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.

es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Denle|Dadle}} gracias al Dios que es más grande que todos los dioses! Su amor fiel dura para siempre.

vi.L: Hãy cảm tạ Đức Chúa Trời của các thần, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời.

ko.L: 신들의 하나님께 감사하여라. 참으로 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다.
ko.B: 신들의 하나님께 감사하여라. 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다.
ko.R: 모든 신보다 크신 하나님께 감사하여라. 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다.

pt.L: Rendam graças ao Deus dos deuses, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre.
pt.B: Rendam graças ao Deus dos deuses, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.
pt.R: Agradeçam ao Deus que é maior do que todos os deuses. O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.

hi.L: देवताओं के परमेश्वर का धन्यवाद करो, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]।

ru.L: Благодарите Бога богов, \q потому что вовек неизменная любовь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Благодарите Бога богов; \q {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь длится вечно.
ru.R: Благодарите Бога, который выше всех богов. \q Его неизменная любовь длится вечно.

ja.L: 神々の神に感謝せよ。 \q その誠実はとこしえに[続く]からである。
ja.B: 神々の中の神に感謝せよ。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く。
ja.R: どんな神々よりも偉大な神に感謝しよう。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。

uk.L: Дякуйте Богові богів, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов — навіки.
uk.B: Дякуйте Богові богів, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов триває навіки.
uk.R: Дякуйте Богові, який більший за всіх богів. \q Його вірна любов триває вічно.

decisions.choice: God of gods: the supreme God
decisions.reason: "God of gods" and "Lord of lords" (verse 3) are the Hebrew way of saying the highest God, the highest Lord, as in Deuteronomy 10:17.

decisions.choice: the God who is greater than all gods
decisions.reason: Readable says what the idiom means (m1).

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.

decisions.choice: "God of gods" (Elohim) as "የአማልክት አምላክ"; Readable "ከአማልክት ሁሉ የሚበልጠውን አምላክ"
decisions.reason: Elohim in a construct phrase needs "አምላክ", as for "our God"; the plural "gods" is "አማልክት", the word used for the nations' gods on main.

decisions.choice: one refrain per level: "क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]" (L); "क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है" (B); "उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है", a sentence of its own (R)
decisions.reason: The refrain closes all 26 verses (meaning m2). It keeps the second half of 1 Chronicles 16:34 at each level, with "क्योंकि" at Balanced as 1 Chronicles 16:41 has it; Readable makes it its own sentence, as the English does. hesed is "अटल प्रेम" at every level, where the English varies "loyal love" and "faithful love".

decisions.choice: "देवताओं के परमेश्वर"; "प्रभुओं के प्रभु" (verse 3)
decisions.reason: The titles keep the Literal wording of Deuteronomy 10:17 in this translation (meaning m1); Readable says what they mean, as the English does.

decisions.choice: the refrain, as in verse 1
decisions.reason: Every verse ends with the refrain of 1 Chronicles 16:34 in its wording for each level; Balanced keeps its semicolon and Readable its separate sentence.

decisions.choice: 'Elohei ha'elohim "神々の神" (L), "神々の中の神" (B), "どんな神々よりも偉大な神" (R); 'Adonei ha'adonim (136:3) "主たちの主" / "主たちの中の主", no span
decisions.reason: As DEU 10:17 (神々の神、主たちの主 L; 神々の中の神、主たちの中の主 B); the supreme God and Lord (m1).

records.literal_gloss: Give thanks to [the] Lord of the lords, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: Give thanks to the Lord of the lords, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: Thank the Lord who rules over all lords. His faithful love lasts forever.

fr.L: Rendez grâce au Seigneur des seigneurs, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.
fr.B: Rendez grâce au Seigneur des seigneurs, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Remerciez le Seigneur qui règne sur tous les seigneurs. Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.L: Mshukuruni Bwana wa mabwana, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele.

vi.L: Hãy cảm tạ Chúa của các chúa, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời.

ko.L: 주들의 주님께 감사하여라. 참으로 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다.

pt.L: Rendam graças ao Senhor dos senhores, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre.
pt.B: Rendam graças ao Senhor dos senhores, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.
pt.R: Agradeçam ao Senhor que governa sobre todos os senhores. O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.

uk.R: Дякуйте Господеві, який панує над усіма володарями. \q Його вірна любов триває вічно.

ru.B: Того, кто один творит великие чудеса; \q {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь длится вечно.

ja.L: ただひとり、大いなる奇しいみわざをなさる方に[感謝せよ]。 \q その誠実はとこしえに[続く]からである。

ja.R: その方だけが、大きな驚くべきことをなさる。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。

uk.L: Тому, [хто] сам чинить великі дива, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов — навіки.

uk.R: Тільки {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} чинить великі дива. \q Його вірна любов триває вічно.

decisions.choice: To the one who: the call to give thanks continues
decisions.reason: Verses 4-7, 10, 13, 16 and 17 begin "to the one who ...", carrying on the call of verses 1-3: give thanks to the one who did these things. Each line is followed by the people's refrain, so each verse is printed as a line of its own.

decisions.choice: who alone does wonders
decisions.reason: God alone does wonders (72:18; 86:10): the acts the psalm goes on to name.

decisions.choice: each line its own sentence
decisions.reason: Readable makes each line a sentence about what God did ("He alone does ..."), and the refrain a sentence of its own (m1).

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.

decisions.choice: "[Hãy cảm tạ] Đấng ..." at Literal
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "to the one who does", carrying on the call to give thanks (see the meaning decision). Vietnamese cannot begin with "to" alone, so Literal supplies the verb in brackets, and "Đấng" stands for the one who acts.

decisions.choice: "... 분께 [감사하여라]" (L), "... 분께 감사하여라" (B) where the Hebrew begins "To the one who" (verses 4-7, 10, 13, 16-17)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew carries the call "give thanks" on from verse 3 (meaning decision); a Korean phrase "to the one" cannot stand without a verb, so Literal supplies it in brackets and Balanced says it. Readable makes each verse a plain statement, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: Àquele que ... (L, B); each line its own sentence (R)
decisions.reason: "Àquele que" carries on the call of verses 1-3, "give thanks to the one who ..." (m1), in verses 4-7, 10, 13, 16 and 17; Literal brackets it because the Hebrew has only the participle. Readable makes each line a sentence of its own, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "To the one who …" as an object of the opening call, "… የሚያደርገውን [አመስግኑ]" (Literal, bracketed), "… አመስግኑ" (Balanced); the verses that continue a sentence (8-9, 11-12, 14-15, 18-22, 24) take a finite verb at Balanced
alternatives: copying the bare Hebrew participle phrase
decisions.reason: Amharic cannot leave "to the one who does" hanging: the call "give thanks" (meaning decision m1) is supplied in brackets at Literal and plainly at Balanced, where the English Balanced leaves it understood.

decisions.choice: "[उनका धन्यवाद करो] जो" (L); "उनका धन्यवाद करो जो" (B); "वे ..." (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew continues the call to give thanks with "to the one who ..." (meaning m1). Hindi needs the verb again: Literal supplies it in brackets, Balanced says it, and Readable makes each line a sentence about what God did, as the English does. Verses 5-17 follow this pattern.

decisions.choice: [Того,] кто (L); Того, кто (B)
decisions.reason: The call to give thanks runs on from verse 3 (m1): Russian благодарите takes the accusative, so the participle lines become [Того,] кто ... and the later lines (8-9, 11-12, 14-15, 18-22, 24) continue that sentence.

decisions.choice: le'oseh "…方に[感謝せよ]" (L), "…方に感謝せよ" (B) in 136:4-7, 10, 13, 16-17; R each line its own sentence "その方は…"
decisions.reason: The call to give thanks continues (m1); Japanese cannot leave "to the one who …" hanging before the refrain, so L supplies it in brackets and B says it, as the English R makes each line a sentence.

decisions.choice: nifla'ot "奇しいみわざ" (L), "不思議なみわざ" (B), "驚くべきこと" (R)
decisions.reason: Psalter form (PSA-3, 26:7).

es.L: Al que hizo los cielos con entendimiento, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal [es] para siempre.
es.B: Al que hizo los cielos con habilidad y sabiduría, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre.
es.R: Con gran habilidad hizo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} los cielos. Su amor fiel dura para siempre.

vi.L: [Hãy cảm tạ] Đấng đã làm nên các tầng trời bằng sự thông sáng, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời.

vi.R: Ngài đã dựng nên các tầng trời thật tài tình. Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.

ko.L: 명철로 하늘을 지으신 분께 [감사하여라]. 참으로 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다.
ko.B: 솜씨와 지혜로 하늘을 지으신 분께 감사하여라. 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 놀라운 솜씨로 하늘을 지으셨다. 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다.

pt.L: [Àquele que] fez os céus com entendimento, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre.
pt.B: Àquele que fez os céus com habilidade e sabedoria, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.
pt.R: Com grande habilidade {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez os céus. O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.

am.L: ሰማያትን በማስተዋል የሠራውን [አመስግኑ]፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ነውና።
am.B: ሰማያትን በጥበብና በማስተዋል የሠራውን አመስግኑ፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።
am.R: ሰማያትን በታላቅ ጥበብ ሠራ። ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

hi.L: [उनका धन्यवाद करो] जिन्होंने समझ से आकाश को बनाया, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]।
hi.B: उनका धन्यवाद करो जिन्होंने कौशल और बुद्धि से आकाश को बनाया, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।
hi.R: उन्होंने बड़े कौशल से आकाश को बनाया। \q उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।

ru.L: [Того,] кто сотворил небеса разумом, \q потому что вовек неизменная любовь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Того, кто сотворил небеса с искусством и мудростью; \q {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь длится вечно.
ru.R: С великим искусством {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} сотворил небеса. \q Его неизменная любовь длится вечно.

ja.L: 英知をもって天を造られた方に[感謝せよ]。 \q その誠実はとこしえに[続く]からである。
ja.B: 知恵と巧みさをもって天を造られた方に感謝せよ。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く。
ja.R: その方は、すばらしい知恵で天を造られた。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。

uk.L: Тому, [хто] створив небеса розумом, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов — навіки.
uk.B: Тому, хто з умінням і мудрістю створив небеса, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов триває навіки.
uk.R: З великим умінням {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} створив небеса. \q Його вірна любов триває вічно.

decisions.choice: understanding: skill and wisdom
decisions.reason: The word (tevunah) is understanding put to work, the skill of a master builder. "By understanding he established the heavens" (Proverbs 3:19; Jeremiah 10:12).

decisions.choice: the order of Genesis 1
decisions.reason: Verses 5-9 follow the days of creation: the heavens, the land and the waters, the great lights (Genesis 1:1-18).

decisions.choice: with skill and wisdom (B); with great skill (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the word (m1).

decisions.choice: each line its own sentence
decisions.reason: As in 136:4.

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.

source.text: לְרֹקַ֣ע הָ֭אָרֶץ עַל־הַמָּ֑יִם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: To [one who] beat out the earth on the waters, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: To [the one who] spread out the earth upon the waters, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: To the one who spread out the land over the waters, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: He spread out the dry land above the waters. His faithful love lasts forever.

fr.L: À [celui qui] a étendu la terre sur les eaux, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.
fr.B: À celui qui a étendu la terre au-dessus des eaux, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Il a étendu la terre ferme au-dessus des eaux. Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.L: Kwa [yule] aliyeitandaza nchi juu ya maji, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele.
sw.B: Kwa yule aliyeitandaza nchi juu ya maji, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.
sw.R: Aliitandaza nchi kavu juu ya maji. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.

es.L: Al que extendió la tierra sobre las aguas, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal [es] para siempre.
es.B: Al que extendió la tierra firme sobre las aguas, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre.
es.R: Extendió la tierra seca por encima de las aguas. Su amor fiel dura para siempre.

vi.L: [Hãy cảm tạ] Đấng đã trải đất ra trên các dòng nước, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời.
vi.B: Hãy cảm tạ Đấng đã trải đất liền ra trên mặt nước, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.
vi.R: Ngài đã trải đất khô ra trên mặt nước. Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.

ko.L: 물 위에 땅을 펴신 분께 [감사하여라]. 참으로 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다.
ko.B: 물 위에 땅을 넓게 펼치신 분께 감사하여라. 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 물 위에 마른 땅을 펼치셨다. 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다.

pt.L: [Àquele que] estendeu a terra sobre as águas, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre.
pt.B: Àquele que estendeu a terra firme sobre as águas, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.
pt.R: Ele estendeu a terra seca por cima das águas. O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.

am.L: ምድርን በውኆች ላይ የዘረጋውን [አመስግኑ]፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ነውና።
am.B: የብሱን በውኆች ላይ የዘረጋውን አመስግኑ፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።
am.R: የብሱን ከውኆች በላይ ዘረጋ። ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

hi.L: [उनका धन्यवाद करो] जिन्होंने पृथ्वी को जल के ऊपर फैलाया, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]।
hi.B: उनका धन्यवाद करो जिन्होंने भूमि को जल के ऊपर फैला दिया, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।
hi.R: उन्होंने सूखी भूमि को जल के ऊपर फैला दिया। \q उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।

ru.L: [Того,] кто распростёр землю над водами, \q потому что вовек неизменная любовь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Того, кто распростёр сушу над водами; \q {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь длится вечно.
ru.R: Он распростёр сушу над водами. \q Его неизменная любовь длится вечно.

ja.L: 水の上に地を打ち広げられた方に[感謝せよ]。 \q その誠実はとこしえに[続く]からである。
ja.B: 水の上に陸地を広げられた方に感謝せよ。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く。
ja.R: その方は、水の上に、かわいた陸地を広げられた。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。

uk.L: Тому, [хто] розпростер землю над водами, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов — навіки.
uk.B: Тому, хто розстелив суходіл над водами, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов триває навіки.
uk.R: Він розстелив суходіл над водами. \q Його вірна любов триває вічно.

decisions.choice: spread out: beat flat, like metal
decisions.reason: The verb (raqa') is to hammer out or spread out, as a smith beats out metal (Isaiah 40:19). Isaiah 42:5 and 44:24 use it of God spreading out the earth.

decisions.choice: the earth on the waters
decisions.reason: The land was pictured as set upon the waters below (24:2), which God had gathered and bounded (Genesis 1:9-10).

decisions.choice: each line its own sentence
decisions.reason: As in 136:4.

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.

decisions.choice: "the earth" spread over the waters as "የብስ" (dry land) at Balanced and Readable; Literal "ምድር"
decisions.reason: The English Balanced and Readable say "land", the sense of meaning decision m2; "የብስ" is the settled word for dry land (Genesis 1 on main).

source.text: לְ֭עֹשֵׂה אוֹרִ֣ים גְּדֹלִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: To [one who] made lights great, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: To [the one who] made great lights, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: To the one who made the great lights, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: He made the great lights in the sky. His faithful love lasts forever.

fr.L: À [celui qui] a fait de grands luminaires, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.
fr.B: À celui qui a fait les grands luminaires, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Il a fait les grandes lumières du ciel. Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.L: Kwa [yule] aliyefanya mianga mikuu, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele.
sw.B: Kwa yule aliyeifanya mianga mikuu, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.
sw.R: Aliifanya mianga mikuu angani. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.

es.L: Al que hizo grandes luminarias, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal [es] para siempre.
es.B: Al que hizo las grandes luminarias, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre.
es.R: Hizo las grandes luces del cielo. Su amor fiel dura para siempre.

vi.L: [Hãy cảm tạ] Đấng đã làm nên những vì sáng lớn, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời.
vi.B: Hãy cảm tạ Đấng đã làm nên những vì sáng lớn, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.
vi.R: Ngài đã làm nên những vì sáng lớn trên bầu trời. Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.

ko.L: 큰 빛들을 지으신 분께 [감사하여라]. 참으로 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다.
ko.B: 큰 빛들을 지으신 분께 감사하여라. 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 하늘에 큰 빛들을 지으셨다. 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다.

pt.L: [Àquele que] fez grandes luzes, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre.
pt.B: Àquele que fez as grandes luzes, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.
pt.R: Ele fez as grandes luzes no céu. O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.

am.L: ታላላቅ ብርሃናትን የሠራውን [አመስግኑ]፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ነውና።
am.B: ታላላቅ ብርሃናትን የሠራውን አመስግኑ፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።
am.R: በሰማይ ታላላቅ ብርሃናትን ሠራ። ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

hi.L: [उनका धन्यवाद करो] जिन्होंने बड़ी-बड़ी ज्योतियाँ बनाईं, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]।
hi.B: उनका धन्यवाद करो जिन्होंने बड़ी-बड़ी ज्योतियाँ बनाईं, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।
hi.R: उन्होंने आकाश में बड़ी-बड़ी ज्योतियाँ बनाईं। \q उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।

ru.L: [Того,] кто сотворил светила великие, \q потому что вовек неизменная любовь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Того, кто сотворил великие светила; \q {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь длится вечно.
ru.R: Он сотворил великие светила на небе. \q Его неизменная любовь длится вечно.

ja.L: 大いなる光を造られた方に[感謝せよ]。 \q その誠実はとこしえに[続く]からである。
ja.B: 大きな光を造られた方に感謝せよ。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く。
ja.R: その方は、空に大きな光を造られた。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。

uk.L: Тому, [хто] створив великі світила, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов — навіки.
uk.B: Тому, хто створив великі світила, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов триває навіки.
uk.R: Він створив великі світила на небі. \q Його вірна любов триває вічно.

decisions.choice: the great lights of Genesis 1
decisions.reason: "God made the two great lights" (Genesis 1:16): the sun and the moon, named in verses 8-9.

decisions.choice: in the sky
decisions.reason: Readable says where the lights are (Genesis 1:14).

decisions.choice: each line its own sentence
decisions.reason: As in 136:4.

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.

source.text: אֶת־הַ֭שֶּׁמֶשׁ לְמֶמְשֶׁ֣לֶת בַּיּ֑וֹם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: the sun for rule in the day, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: the sun for rule by day, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: the sun to rule by day, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: He made the sun to rule the day. His faithful love lasts forever.

fr.L: le soleil pour gouverner le jour, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.
fr.B: le soleil pour gouverner le jour, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Il a fait le soleil pour gouverner le jour. Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.L: jua kwa kutawala mchana, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele.
sw.B: jua litawale mchana, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.
sw.R: Alilifanya jua litawale mchana. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.

es.L: el sol para dominar de día, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal [es] para siempre.
es.B: el sol para gobernar el día, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre.
es.R: Hizo el sol para gobernar el día. Su amor fiel dura para siempre.

vi.L: mặt trời để cai quản ban ngày, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời.
vi.B: làm nên mặt trời để cai quản ban ngày, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.
vi.R: Ngài làm nên mặt trời để cai quản ban ngày. Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.

ko.L: 낮을 다스리도록 해를 [지으셨다]. 참으로 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다.
ko.B: 낮을 다스리도록 해를 지으셨다. 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 해를 지으셔서 낮을 다스리게 하셨다. 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다.

pt.L: o sol para governar de dia, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre.
pt.B: o sol para governar o dia, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.
pt.R: Ele fez o sol para governar o dia. O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.

am.B: ፀሐይን በቀን እንድትገዛ ሠራ፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

hi.L: दिन पर प्रभुता के लिए सूर्य को, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]।
hi.B: दिन पर शासन करने के लिए सूर्य को, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।
hi.R: उन्होंने दिन पर राज करने के लिए सूरज को बनाया। \q उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।

ru.L: солнце — для власти днём, \q потому что вовек неизменная любовь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: солнце, чтобы управлять днём; \q {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь длится вечно.
ru.R: Он сотворил солнце, чтобы оно управляло днём. \q Его неизменная любовь длится вечно.

ja.L: 昼を治めるための太陽を[造られた]。 \q その誠実はとこしえに[続く]からである。
ja.B: 昼を治めるために、太陽を造られた。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く。
ja.R: その方は、昼を治める太陽を造られた。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。

uk.L: сонце, щоб панувати вдень, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов — навіки.
uk.B: сонце, щоб панувало вдень, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов триває навіки.
uk.R: Він створив сонце, щоб воно панувало вдень. \q Його вірна любов триває вічно.

records.literal_gloss: the moon and stars for rule in the night, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: the moon and stars for rule by night, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: the moon and the stars to rule by night, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: He made the moon and the stars to rule the night. His faithful love lasts forever.

fr.L: la lune et les étoiles pour gouverner la nuit, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.
fr.B: la lune et les étoiles pour gouverner la nuit, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Il a fait la lune et les étoiles pour gouverner la nuit. Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.L: mwezi na nyota kwa kutawala usiku, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele.
sw.B: mwezi na nyota vitawale usiku, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.
sw.R: Aliufanya mwezi na nyota vitawale usiku. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.

es.L: la luna y las estrellas para dominar de noche, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal [es] para siempre.
es.B: la luna y las estrellas para gobernar la noche, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre.
es.R: Hizo la luna y las estrellas para gobernar la noche. Su amor fiel dura para siempre.

vi.L: mặt trăng và các ngôi sao để cai quản ban đêm, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời.
vi.B: làm nên mặt trăng và các ngôi sao để cai quản ban đêm, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.
vi.R: Ngài làm nên mặt trăng và các ngôi sao để cai quản ban đêm. Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.

ko.L: 밤을 다스리도록 달과 별들을 [지으셨다]. 참으로 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다.
ko.B: 밤을 다스리도록 달과 별들을 지으셨다. 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 달과 별들을 지으셔서 밤을 다스리게 하셨다. 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다.

pt.L: a lua e [as] estrelas para governar de noite, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre.
pt.B: a lua e as estrelas para governar a noite, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.
pt.R: Ele fez a lua e as estrelas para governar a noite. O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.

am.L: በሌሊት እንዲገዙ ጨረቃንና ከዋክብትን [የሠራውን]፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ነውና።
am.B: ጨረቃንና ከዋክብትን በሌሊት እንዲገዙ ሠራ፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።
am.R: ሌሊትን እንዲገዙ ጨረቃንና ከዋክብትን ሠራ። ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

hi.L: रात पर प्रभुता के लिए चंद्रमा और तारों को, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]।
hi.B: रात पर शासन करने के लिए चंद्रमा और तारों को, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।
hi.R: उन्होंने रात पर राज करने के लिए चाँद और तारों को बनाया। \q उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।

ru.L: луну и звёзды — для власти ночью, \q потому что вовек неизменная любовь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: луну и звёзды, чтобы управлять ночью; \q {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь длится вечно.
ru.R: Он сотворил луну и звёзды, чтобы они управляли ночью. \q Его неизменная любовь длится вечно.

ja.L: 夜を治めるための月と星を[造られた]。 \q その誠実はとこしえに[続く]からである。
ja.B: 夜を治めるために、月と星を造られた。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く。
ja.R: その方は、夜を治める月と星を造られた。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。

uk.L: місяць і зорі, щоб панувати вночі, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов — навіки.
uk.B: місяць і зорі, щоб панували вночі, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов триває навіки.
uk.R: Він створив місяць і зорі, щоб вони панували вночі. \q Його вірна любов триває вічно.

decisions.reason: As in verse 8 (Genesis 1:16).

decisions.reason: As in 136:1.

records.literal_gloss: To [one who] struck Egypt in their firstborn, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: To [the one who] struck Egypt in their firstborn, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: To the one who struck Egypt through their firstborn, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: He punished Egypt by killing their oldest sons. His faithful love lasts forever.

fr.L: À [celui qui] a frappé l’Égypte dans ses premiers-nés, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.
fr.B: À celui qui a frappé l’Égypte en ses premiers-nés, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Il a puni l’Égypte en faisant mourir ses fils aînés. Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.L: Kwa [yule] aliyeipiga Misri katika wazaliwa wao wa kwanza, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele.
sw.B: Kwa yule aliyeipiga Misri kupitia wazaliwa wao wa kwanza, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.
sw.R: Aliiadhibu Misri kwa kuwaua wana wao wa kwanza. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.

es.L: Al que hirió a Egipto en sus primogénitos, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal [es] para siempre.
es.B: Al que hirió a Egipto en sus primogénitos, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre.
es.R: Castigó a Egipto matando a sus hijos mayores. Su amor fiel dura para siempre.

vi.L: [Hãy cảm tạ] Đấng đã đánh Ai Cập nơi các con đầu lòng của chúng, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời.
vi.B: Hãy cảm tạ Đấng đã đánh phạt Ai Cập qua các con đầu lòng của chúng, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.
vi.R: Ngài đã trừng phạt Ai Cập bằng cách giết các con trai cả của chúng. Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.

ko.L: 이집트를 그들의 맏이들로 치신 분께 [감사하여라]. 참으로 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다.
ko.B: 맏이들을 치심으로 이집트를 치신 분께 감사하여라. 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 이집트의 맏아들들을 죽이셔서 이집트를 벌하셨다. 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다.

pt.L: [Àquele que] feriu o Egito nos seus primogênitos, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre.
pt.B: Àquele que feriu o Egito por meio dos seus primogênitos, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.
pt.R: Ele castigou o Egito matando os filhos mais velhos dos egípcios. O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.

am.L: ግብፅን በበኩሮቻቸው የመታውን [አመስግኑ]፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ነውና።
am.B: ግብፅን በበኩሮቿ በኩል የመታውን አመስግኑ፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።
am.R: የግብፅን የበኩር ወንድ ልጆች በመግደል ግብፅን ቀጣ። ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

hi.L: [उनका धन्यवाद करो] जिन्होंने मिस्र को उसके पहलौठों में मारा, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]।
hi.B: उनका धन्यवाद करो जिन्होंने मिस्र के पहलौठों के द्वारा उस पर प्रहार किया, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।
hi.R: उन्होंने मिस्रियों के सबसे बड़े बेटों को मारकर मिस्र को दंड दिया। \q उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।

ru.L: [Того,] кто поразил Египет в первенцах его, \q потому что вовек неизменная любовь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Того, кто поразил Египет через его первенцев; \q {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь длится вечно.
ru.R: Он наказал Египет, убив старших сыновей египтян. \q Его неизменная любовь длится вечно.

ja.L: エジプトを、その初子においてお打ちになった方に[感謝せよ]。 \q その誠実はとこしえに[続く]からである。
ja.B: エジプトの初子をお打ちになった方に感謝せよ。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く。
ja.R: その方は、エジプトの長男たちを死なせ、エジプトに罰をお与えになった。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。

uk.L: Тому, [хто] уразив Єгипет у їхніх первістках, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов — навіки.
uk.B: Тому, хто уразив Єгипет через їхніх первістків, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов триває навіки.
uk.R: Він покарав Єгипет, убивши їхніх старших синів. \q Його вірна любов триває вічно.

decisions.reason: As in 136:4.

records.literal_gloss: and he brought out Israel from among them, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brought Israel out from among them, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} led Israel out from among them, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: He brought Israel out from among the Egyptians. His faithful love lasts forever.

fr.L: et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait sortir Israël du milieu d’eux, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.
fr.B: et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait sortir Israël du milieu d’eux, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Il a fait sortir Israël du milieu des Égyptiens. Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.L: na akawatoa Israeli kutoka kati yao, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele.
sw.B: na akawaongoza Israeli kutoka kati yao, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.
sw.R: Aliwatoa Israeli kutoka kati ya Wamisri. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.

es.L: y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sacó a Israel de en medio de ellos, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal [es] para siempre.
es.B: y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sacó a Israel de en medio de ellos, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre.
es.R: Sacó a Israel de en medio de los egipcios. Su amor fiel dura para siempre.

vi.L: và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đem Y-sơ-ra-ên ra khỏi giữa chúng, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời.
vi.B: và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dẫn Y-sơ-ra-ên ra khỏi giữa chúng, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.
vi.R: Ngài đã đem Y-sơ-ra-ên ra khỏi giữa người Ai Cập. Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.

ko.L: 그리고 그들 가운데서 이스라엘을 이끌어 내셨다. 참으로 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다.
ko.B: 그리고 그들 가운데서 이스라엘을 인도해 내셨다. 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 이집트 사람들 가운데서 이스라엘을 이끌어 내셨다. 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다.

pt.L: e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tirou Israel do meio deles, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre.
pt.B: e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} conduziu Israel para fora do meio deles, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.
pt.R: Ele tirou Israel do meio dos egípcios. O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.

am.L: እስራኤልንም ከመካከላቸው ያወጣውን፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ነውና።
am.B: እስራኤልንም ከመካከላቸው አወጣ፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።
am.R: እስራኤልን ከግብፃውያን መካከል አወጣ። ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

hi.L: और वे इस्राएल को उनके बीच में से निकाल लाए, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]।
hi.B: और वे इस्राएल को उनके बीच से निकाल ले गए, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।
hi.R: वे इस्राएल को मिस्रियों के बीच से निकाल लाए। \q उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।

ru.L: и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} вывел Израиль из среды их, \q потому что вовек неизменная любовь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} вывел Израиль из их среды; \q {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь длится вечно.
ru.R: Он вывел Израиль из среды египтян. \q Его неизменная любовь длится вечно.

ja.L: そして、彼らの中からイスラエルを連れ出された。 \q その誠実はとこしえに[続く]からである。
ja.B: そして、彼らの中からイスラエルを導き出された。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く。
ja.R: その方は、エジプト人の中から、イスラエルを連れ出してくださった。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。

uk.L: і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} вивів Ізраїля з-поміж них, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов — навіки.
uk.B: і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} вивів Ізраїля з-посеред них, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов триває навіки.
uk.R: Він вивів Ізраїля з-посеред єгиптян. \q Його вірна любов триває вічно.

decisions.choice: the exodus
decisions.reason: "The LORD brought the Israelites out of the land of Egypt" (Exodus 12:51).

decisions.choice: the Egyptians
decisions.reason: Readable says who "them" are.

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.

source.text: בְּיָ֣ד חֲ֭זָקָה וּבִזְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: with a hand strong and with an arm outstretched, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: with a strong hand and with an outstretched arm, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: with a strong hand and a stretched-out arm, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: He did it with great power, reaching out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} strong arm. His faithful love lasts forever.

fr.L: d’une main forte et d’un bras étendu, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.
fr.B: d’une main forte et d’un bras tendu, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Il l’a fait avec une grande puissance, en tendant {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bras puissant. Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.L: kwa mkono wenye nguvu na kwa mkono ulionyoshwa, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele.
sw.B: kwa mkono wenye nguvu na mkono ulionyooshwa, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.
sw.R: Alifanya hivyo kwa uweza mkubwa, akinyoosha mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wenye nguvu. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.

es.L: con mano fuerte y con brazo extendido, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal [es] para siempre.
es.B: con mano fuerte y brazo extendido, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre.
es.R: Lo hizo con gran poder, extendiendo {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} brazo fuerte. Su amor fiel dura para siempre.

vi.L: bằng bàn tay mạnh mẽ và cánh tay giơ ra, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời.
vi.B: bằng bàn tay mạnh mẽ và cánh tay dang ra, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.
vi.R: Ngài làm điều đó bằng quyền năng lớn lao, bằng cánh tay mạnh mẽ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.

ko.L: 강한 손과 뻗친 팔로 [이끌어 내셨다]. 참으로 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다.
ko.B: 강한 손과 쭉 뻗은 팔로 이끌어 내셨다. 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 힘센 팔을 뻗어 큰 능력으로 그 일을 하셨다. 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다.

pt.L: com mão forte e com braço estendido, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre.
pt.B: com mão poderosa e braço estendido, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.
pt.R: Ele fez isso com grande poder, estendendo o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} braço forte. O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.

am.L: በብርቱ እጅና በተዘረጋ ክንድ [ያወጣውን]፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ነውና።
am.B: በብርቱ እጅና በተዘረጋ ክንድ አወጣቸው፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።
am.R: ይህንም ያደረገው ብርቱ ክንዱን ዘርግቶ በታላቅ ኃይል ነው። ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

hi.L: बलवंत हाथ और बढ़ाई हुई भुजा से, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]।
hi.B: बलवंत हाथ और बढ़ाई हुई भुजा के साथ, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।
hi.R: उन्होंने यह बड़ी शक्ति से, अपनी बलवंत भुजा बढ़ाकर किया। \q उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।

ru.L: рукой сильной и рукой простёртой, \q потому что вовек неизменная любовь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: сильной рукой и простёртой рукой; \q {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь длится вечно.
ru.R: Он сделал это великой силой, протянув свою могучую руку. \q Его неизменная любовь длится вечно.

ja.L: 強い手と伸ばされた腕をもって。 \q その誠実はとこしえに[続く]からである。
ja.B: 力強い手と、伸ばされた腕によって。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く。
ja.R: その方は、大きな力で、強い腕を伸ばして、そうしてくださった。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。

uk.L: сильною рукою і простягненим раменом, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов — навіки.
uk.B: могутньою рукою і простягнутим раменом, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов триває навіки.
uk.R: Він зробив це з великою силою, простягнувши свою сильну руку. \q Його вірна любов триває вічно.

decisions.choice: a strong hand and an outstretched arm: great power
decisions.reason: The phrase is used again and again of the exodus (Deuteronomy 4:34; 5:15; 26:8). The hand and arm are pictures of God's power in action, the arm stretched out to strike.

decisions.choice: with great power, reaching out his strong arm
alternatives: with a strong hand and an outstretched arm
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means and keeps the arm (m1).

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.

source.text: לְגֹזֵ֣ר יַם־ס֭וּף לִגְזָרִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: To [one who] cut [the] Sea of Reeds into pieces, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: To [the one who] cut the Sea of Reeds into pieces, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: To the one who split the Red Sea apart, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: He split the Red Sea apart. His faithful love lasts forever.

fr.L: À [celui qui] a coupé en morceaux la mer des Joncs, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.
fr.B: À celui qui a fendu la mer Rouge en deux, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Il a fendu la mer Rouge en deux. Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.L: Kwa [yule] aliyeigawa Bahari ya Matete vipande vipande, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele.
sw.B: Kwa yule aliyeipasua Bahari ya Shamu, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.
sw.R: Aliipasua Bahari ya Shamu. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.

es.L: Al que partió en pedazos el mar de los Juncos, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal [es] para siempre.
es.B: Al que partió en dos el mar Rojo, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre.
es.R: Partió en dos el mar Rojo. Su amor fiel dura para siempre.

vi.L: [Hãy cảm tạ] Đấng đã chia cắt Biển Sậy ra từng phần, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời.
vi.B: Hãy cảm tạ Đấng đã rẽ Biển Đỏ ra làm hai, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.
vi.R: Ngài đã rẽ Biển Đỏ ra làm hai. Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.

ko.L: 갈대 바다를 조각조각 가르신 분께 [감사하여라]. 참으로 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다.
ko.B: 홍해를 둘로 가르신 분께 감사하여라. 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 홍해를 둘로 가르셨다. 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다.

pt.L: [Àquele que] cortou em pedaços o mar dos Juncos, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre.
pt.B: Àquele que dividiu o mar Vermelho ao meio, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.
pt.R: Ele dividiu o mar Vermelho ao meio. O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.

am.L: የሸምበቆን ባሕር ቆራርጦ የከፈለውን [አመስግኑ]፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ነውና።
am.B: ቀይ ባሕርን ለሁለት የከፈለውን አመስግኑ፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።
am.R: ቀይ ባሕርን ለሁለት ከፈለ። ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

hi.L: [उनका धन्यवाद करो] जिन्होंने सरकंडों के समुद्र को टुकड़ों में काट दिया, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]।
hi.B: उनका धन्यवाद करो जिन्होंने लाल समुद्र को चीरकर दो भाग कर दिया, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।
hi.R: उन्होंने लाल समुद्र को चीरकर दो भाग कर दिया। \q उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।

ru.L: [Того,] кто рассёк Тростниковое море на части, \q потому что вовек неизменная любовь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Того, кто рассёк Красное море надвое; \q {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь длится вечно.
ru.R: Он рассёк Красное море надвое. \q Его неизменная любовь длится вечно.

ja.L: 葦の海を二つに断ち切られた方に[感謝せよ]。 \q その誠実はとこしえに[続く]からである。
ja.B: 紅海を二つに分けられた方に感謝せよ。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く。
ja.R: その方は、紅海を二つに分けられた。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。

uk.L: Тому, [хто] розітнув Очеретяне море на частини, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов — навіки.
uk.B: Тому, хто розділив Червоне море навпіл, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов триває навіки.
uk.R: Він розділив Червоне море навпіл. \q Його вірна любов триває вічно.

decisions.choice: the Sea of Reeds: the sea Israel crossed, known as the Red Sea
decisions.reason: The name (yam suf) means "sea of reeds". It is the sea of the crossing (Exodus 15:4, 22). The ancient Greek translation calls it the Red Sea, the name long used for it.

decisions.choice: cut into pieces: split in two
decisions.reason: The verb (gazar) is to cut, and the noun (gezarim) is the pieces: the sea was divided (Exodus 14:21). The same noun is used of the halves of the animals in God's covenant with Abraham (Genesis 15:17).

decisions.choice: the Red Sea
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the familiar name, as in Exodus; Literal translates the Hebrew name, "Sea of Reeds".

decisions.choice: each line its own sentence
decisions.reason: As in 136:4.

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.

decisions.choice: "la mer des Joncs" (Literal); "la mer Rouge" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name is "Sea of Reeds"; Literal translates it, and the other levels use the name the sea is known by, as the English does and as Exodus 15:4 does in French.

decisions.choice: "Bahari ya Matete" (Sea of Reeds) at Literal; "Bahari ya Shamu" (the Red Sea) at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name means "Sea of Reeds". Literal shows that, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable use the name Swahili readers know for the sea Israel crossed.

decisions.choice: "Biển Sậy" (L); "Biển Đỏ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name means "Sea of Reeds"; it is the sea Israel crossed, known as the Red Sea (see the meaning decision). Literal keeps the Hebrew name; the other levels use the name Vietnamese readers know, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "갈대 바다" (L), "홍해" (B, R) for the Sea of Reeds (verses 13, 15)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew name; Balanced and Readable use the name by which Korean readers know the sea Israel crossed, as the English does (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: o mar dos Juncos (L); o mar Vermelho (B, R)
decisions.reason: As Exodus 15:4 in Portuguese: Literal translates the Hebrew name, Balanced and Readable use the familiar one (m1). The verbs and names of the exodus and the conquest (verses 10-20) follow the Portuguese of Exodus and Numbers: "sacudiu" (Exodus 14:27), "com mão forte e com braço estendido" (Deuteronomy 26:8), "Seom, rei dos amorreus", "Ogue, rei de Basã".

decisions.choice: the Sea of Reeds as "የሸምበቆ ባሕር" (Literal), "ቀይ ባሕር" (Balanced, Readable), here and in verse 15
decisions.reason: As Deuteronomy 1:40 and 1 Kings 9:26 on main: Literal keeps the Hebrew name, Balanced and Readable the name Amharic readers know (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "सरकंडों का समुद्र" (L); "लाल समुद्र" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Exodus, Deuteronomy 11:4 and Joshua 2:10 in this translation: Literal translates the Hebrew name, Balanced and Readable use the familiar name, as Acts 7:36 does.

decisions.choice: Тростниковое море (L); Красное море (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 15:4 and the rest of the Pentateuch in this translation: Literal translates the Hebrew name, Balanced and Readable use the familiar one (m1).

decisions.choice: yam-suf "葦の海" (L), "紅海" (B, R), also 136:15
decisions.reason: As 106:7-22 (PSA-11); the sea known as the Red Sea (m1).

source.text: וְהֶעֱבִ֣יר יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל בְּתוֹכ֑וֹ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: and he made pass Israel in its middle, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made Israel pass through the middle of it, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brought Israel through the middle of it, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: He led Israel right through the middle of the sea. His faithful love lasts forever.

fr.L: et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait passer Israël au milieu d’elle, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.
fr.B: et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait passer Israël au milieu d’elle, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Il a conduit Israël tout droit au milieu de la mer. Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.L: na akawapitisha Israeli katikati yake, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele.
sw.B: na akawavusha Israeli katikati yake, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.
sw.R: Aliwaongoza Israeli kupita katikati kabisa ya bahari. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.

es.L: y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hizo pasar a Israel por en medio de él, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal [es] para siempre.
es.B: y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} llevó a Israel por en medio de él, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre.
es.R: Llevó a Israel justo por en medio del mar. Su amor fiel dura para siempre.

vi.L: và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã cho Y-sơ-ra-ên đi qua giữa biển, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời.
vi.B: và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dẫn Y-sơ-ra-ên đi qua giữa biển, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.
vi.R: Ngài dẫn Y-sơ-ra-ên đi ngay giữa lòng biển. Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘을 그 가운데로 지나가게 하셨다. 참으로 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다.
ko.B: 그리고 이스라엘이 그 한가운데로 건너가게 하셨다. 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 이스라엘을 이끄시고 바다 한가운데를 지나가게 하셨다. 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다.

pt.L: e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez Israel passar pelo meio dele, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre.
pt.B: e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} levou Israel pelo meio dele, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.
pt.R: Ele levou Israel bem pelo meio do mar. O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.

am.L: እስራኤልንም በመካከሉ ያሳለፈውን፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ነውና።
am.B: እስራኤልንም በመካከሉ አሳለፈ፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።
am.R: እስራኤልን በባሕሩ መካከል አሻግሮ መራ። ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

hi.L: और उन्होंने इस्राएल को उसके बीच से पार कराया, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]।
hi.B: और वे इस्राएल को उसके बीच से पार ले गए, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।
hi.R: वे इस्राएल को समुद्र के ठीक बीच से पार ले गए। \q उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।

ru.L: и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} провёл Израиль посреди него, \q потому что вовек неизменная любовь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} провёл Израиль через его середину; \q {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь длится вечно.
ru.R: Он провёл Израиль прямо посреди моря. \q Его неизменная любовь длится вечно.

ja.L: そして、イスラエルにその中を通らせた。 \q その誠実はとこしえに[続く]からである。
ja.B: そして、イスラエルにその真ん中を通らせた。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く。
ja.R: その方は、イスラエルを導いて、海の真ん中を通らせてくださった。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。

uk.L: і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} провів Ізраїля посеред нього, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов — навіки.
uk.B: і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} перевів Ізраїля посеред нього, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов триває навіки.
uk.R: Він провів Ізраїля просто посередині моря. \q Його вірна любов триває вічно.

decisions.choice: through the middle of the sea
decisions.reason: "The Israelites went into the middle of the sea on dry ground" (Exodus 14:22).

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.

source.text: וְנִ֘עֵ֤ר פַּרְעֹ֣ה וְחֵיל֣וֹ בְיַם־ס֑וּף כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: and he shook off Pharaoh and his army in [the] Sea of Reeds, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} shook off Pharaoh and his army in the Sea of Reeds, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} shook Pharaoh and his army off into the Red Sea, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: He threw Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea. His faithful love lasts forever.

fr.L: et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a secoué Pharaon et son armée dans la mer des Joncs, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.
fr.B: et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a précipité Pharaon et son armée dans la mer Rouge, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Il a jeté Pharaon et son armée dans la mer Rouge. Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.L: na akamkung'uta Farao na jeshi lake katika Bahari ya Matete, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele.
sw.B: na akamkung'uta Farao na jeshi lake ndani ya Bahari ya Shamu, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.
sw.R: Alimtupa Farao na jeshi lake ndani ya Bahari ya Shamu. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.

es.L: y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sacudió al faraón y a su ejército en el mar de los Juncos, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal [es] para siempre.
es.B: y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sacudió al faraón y a su ejército dentro del mar Rojo, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre.
es.R: Arrojó al faraón y a su ejército al mar Rojo. Su amor fiel dura para siempre.

vi.L: và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hất Pha-ra-ôn và quân đội của vua xuống Biển Sậy, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời.
vi.B: và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hất Pha-ra-ôn cùng quân đội của vua xuống Biển Đỏ, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.
vi.R: Ngài đã ném Pha-ra-ôn và quân đội của vua xuống Biển Đỏ. Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.

ko.L: 그리고 바로와 그의 군대를 갈대 바다에 떨쳐 버리셨다. 참으로 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다.
ko.B: 그리고 바로와 그의 군대를 홍해에 털어 넣으셨다. 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 바로와 그의 군대를 홍해에 던져 넣으셨다. 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다.

pt.L: e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} sacudiu Faraó e o seu exército no mar dos Juncos, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre.
pt.B: e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} sacudiu Faraó e o seu exército para dentro do mar Vermelho, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.
pt.R: Ele jogou Faraó e o seu exército no mar Vermelho. O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.

am.L: ፈርዖንንና ሠራዊቱንም በሸምበቆ ባሕር ያራገፈውን፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ነውና።
am.B: ፈርዖንንና ሠራዊቱን ግን ወደ ቀይ ባሕር አራገፋቸው፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።
am.R: ፈርዖንንና ሠራዊቱን ወደ ቀይ ባሕር ወረወራቸው። ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

hi.L: और उन्होंने फ़िरौन और उसकी सेना को सरकंडों के समुद्र में झाड़ दिया, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]।
hi.B: और उन्होंने फ़िरौन और उसकी सेना को झाड़कर लाल समुद्र में डाल दिया, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।
hi.R: उन्होंने फ़िरौन और उसकी सेना को लाल समुद्र में फेंक दिया। \q उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।

ru.L: и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} стряхнул фараона и войско его в Тростниковое море, \q потому что вовек неизменная любовь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} стряхнул фараона и его войско в Красное море; \q {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь длится вечно.
ru.R: Он бросил фараона и его войско в Красное море. \q Его неизменная любовь длится вечно.

ja.L: そして、ファラオとその軍勢を葦の海に振り落とされた。 \q その誠実はとこしえに[続く]からである。
ja.B: そして、ファラオとその軍勢を紅海に振り落とされた。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く。
ja.R: その方は、ファラオとその軍隊を紅海に投げ込まれた。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。

uk.L: і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} струсив фараона і його військо в Очеретяне море, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов — навіки.
uk.B: і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} скинув фараона і його військо в Червоне море, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов триває навіки.
uk.R: Він кинув фараона і його військо в Червоне море. \q Його вірна любов триває вічно.

decisions.choice: shook off: the word of Exodus 14:27
decisions.reason: The verb (na'ar) is to shake off or shake out, as dust from clothing. Exodus 14:27 uses it: "the LORD shook off the Egyptians into the middle of the sea".

decisions.choice: the Sea of Reeds: the sea Israel crossed, known as the Red Sea
decisions.reason: The name (yam suf) means "sea of reeds". It is the sea of the crossing (Exodus 15:4, 22). The ancient Greek translation calls it the Red Sea, the name long used for it.

decisions.choice: the Red Sea
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the familiar name, as in Exodus; Literal translates the Hebrew name, "Sea of Reeds".

decisions.choice: threw
decisions.reason: Readable uses a plain verb for the picture of shaking something off (m1).

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.
The verb is that of Exodus 14:27 (meaning m1), where this translation says "झाड़ दिया" at Literal and Balanced and "फेंक दिया" at Readable.

decisions.choice: стряхнул (L, B); бросил (R)
decisions.reason: The verb of Exodus 14:27 (m1), in that verse's Russian wording at each level.

decisions.choice: ni'er "振り落とされた" (L, B), "投げ込まれた" (R)
decisions.reason: The word of Exodus 14:27 (m1).

source.text: לְמוֹלִ֣יךְ עַ֭מּוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: To [one who] led his people in the wilderness, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: To [the one who] led {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people in the wilderness, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: To the one who guided {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people through the wilderness, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: He led {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people through the desert. His faithful love lasts forever.

fr.L: À [celui qui] a conduit {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple dans le désert, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.
fr.B: À celui qui a guidé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple à travers le désert, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Il a conduit {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple à travers le désert. Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.L: Kwa [yule] aliyewaongoza watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} nyikani, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele.
sw.B: Kwa yule aliyewaongoza watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kupitia jangwani, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.
sw.R: Aliwaongoza watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kupitia jangwa. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.

es.L: Al que guió a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo en el desierto, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal [es] para siempre.
es.B: Al que condujo a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo por el desierto, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre.
es.R: Guió a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo por el desierto. Su amor fiel dura para siempre.

vi.L: [Hãy cảm tạ] Đấng đã dẫn dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong đồng vắng, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời.
vi.B: Hãy cảm tạ Đấng đã dẫn dắt dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} qua đồng hoang, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.
vi.R: Ngài đã dẫn dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đi qua sa mạc. Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.

ko.L: 광야에서 그분의 백성을 이끄신 분께 [감사하여라]. 참으로 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다.
ko.B: 광야를 지나도록 그분의 백성을 인도하신 분께 감사하여라. 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 그분의 백성을 이끌고 사막을 지나가셨다. 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다.

pt.L: [Àquele que] conduziu o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo no deserto, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre.
pt.B: Àquele que guiou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo pelo deserto, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.
pt.R: Ele conduziu o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo pelo deserto. O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.

am.L: ሕዝቡን በምድረ በዳ የመራውን [አመስግኑ]፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ነውና።
am.B: ሕዝቡን በምድረ በዳ የመራውን አመስግኑ፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።
am.R: ሕዝቡን በበረሃ ውስጥ መራ። ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

hi.L: [उनका धन्यवाद करो] जो अपनी प्रजा को निर्जन प्रदेश में ले चले, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]।
hi.B: उनका धन्यवाद करो जो अपनी प्रजा को निर्जन प्रदेश में से ले गए, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।
hi.R: वे अपने लोगों को सुनसान इलाक़े में से ले गए। \q उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।

ru.L: [Того,] кто вёл народ свой в пустыне, \q потому что вовек неизменная любовь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Того, кто провёл свой народ через пустыню; \q {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь длится вечно.
ru.R: Он вёл свой народ через пустыню. \q Его неизменная любовь длится вечно.

ja.L: 荒れ野でご自分の民を導かれた方に[感謝せよ]。 \q その誠実はとこしえに[続く]からである。
ja.B: 荒れ野を通って、ご自分の民を導かれた方に感謝せよ。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く。
ja.R: その方は、砂漠の中で、ご自分の民を導いてくださった。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。

uk.L: Тому, [хто] провів свій народ пустелею, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов — навіки.
uk.B: Тому, хто вів свій народ через пустелю, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов триває навіки.
uk.R: Він провів свій народ через пустелю. \q Його вірна любов триває вічно.

decisions.choice: forty years in the wilderness
decisions.reason: The LORD led Israel for forty years through the wilderness between Egypt and the land (Deuteronomy 8:2, 15).

decisions.choice: each line its own sentence
decisions.reason: As in 136:4.

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.

decisions.choice: "निर्जन प्रदेश" (L, B); "सुनसान इलाक़ा" (R)
decisions.reason: The wilderness keeps the terms of the Pentateuch note and Matthew in this translation.

records.literal_gloss: To [one who] struck kings great, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: To [the one who] struck great kings, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: To the one who struck down great kings, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: He defeated great kings. His faithful love lasts forever.

fr.L: À [celui qui] a frappé de grands rois, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.
fr.B: À celui qui a abattu de grands rois, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Il a vaincu de grands rois. Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.L: Kwa [yule] aliyewapiga wafalme wakuu, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele.
sw.B: Kwa yule aliyewaangusha wafalme wakuu, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.
sw.R: Aliwashinda wafalme wakuu. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.

es.L: Al que hirió a grandes reyes, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal [es] para siempre.
es.B: Al que derrotó a grandes reyes, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre.
es.R: Derrotó a grandes reyes. Su amor fiel dura para siempre.

vi.L: [Hãy cảm tạ] Đấng đã đánh các vua lớn, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời.
vi.B: Hãy cảm tạ Đấng đã đánh hạ các vua lớn, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.
vi.R: Ngài đã đánh bại các vua lớn. Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.

ko.L: 큰 왕들을 치신 분께 [감사하여라]. 참으로 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다.
ko.B: 큰 왕들을 쳐부수신 분께 감사하여라. 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 큰 왕들을 물리치셨다. 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다.

pt.L: [Àquele que] feriu grandes reis, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre.
pt.B: Àquele que abateu grandes reis, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.
pt.R: Ele derrotou grandes reis. O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.

am.L: ታላላቅ ነገሥታትን የመታውን [አመስግኑ]፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ነውና።

hi.L: [उनका धन्यवाद करो] जिन्होंने बड़े-बड़े राजाओं को मारा, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]।

hi.R: उन्होंने बड़े-बड़े राजाओं को हराया। \q उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।

ru.L: [Того,] кто поразил царей великих, \q потому что вовек неизменная любовь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Того, кто сразил великих царей; \q {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь длится вечно.
ru.R: Он победил великих царей. \q Его неизменная любовь длится вечно.

ja.L: 大いなる王たちをお打ちになった方に[感謝せよ]。 \q その誠実はとこしえに[続く]からである。
ja.B: 偉大な王たちを打ち倒された方に感謝せよ。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く。
ja.R: その方は、偉大な王たちを打ち負かされた。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。

uk.L: Тому, [хто] уразив великих царів, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов — навіки.
uk.B: Тому, хто уразив великих царів, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов триває навіки.
uk.R: Він переміг великих царів. \q Його вірна любов триває вічно.

es.B: y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mató a reyes poderosos, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre.

vi.L: và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giết các vua hùng mạnh, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời.

vi.R: Ngài đã giết Óc, vua Ba-san. Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.

ko.L: 그리고 바산 왕 옥을 [죽이셨다]. 참으로 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다.
ko.B: 바산 왕 옥도 죽이셨다. 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 바산 왕 옥을 죽이셨다. 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다.

pt.L: e Ogue, rei de Basã, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre.
pt.B: e Ogue, rei de Basã, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.
pt.R: Ele matou Ogue, rei de Basã. O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.

am.L: የባሳንንም ንጉሥ ዐግን [የገደለውን]፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ነውና።
am.B: የባሳንንም ንጉሥ ዐግን ገደለ፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።
am.R: የባሳንን ንጉሥ ዐግን ገደለ። ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

hi.L: और बाशान के राजा ओग को, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]।
hi.B: और बाशान के राजा ओग को, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।
hi.R: उन्होंने बाशान के राजा ओग को मार डाला। \q उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।

ru.L: и Ога, царя Васана, \q потому что вовек неизменная любовь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: и Ога, царя Васана; \q {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь длится вечно.
ru.R: Он убил Ога, царя Васана. \q Его неизменная любовь длится вечно.

ja.L: また、バシャンの王オグを[殺された]。 \q その誠実はとこしえに[続く]からである。
ja.B: また、バシャンの王オグを殺された。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く。
ja.R: その方は、バシャンの王オグを殺された。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。

uk.L: і Ога, царя Башану, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов — навіки.
uk.B: і Ога, царя Башану, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов триває навіки.
uk.R: Він убив Ога, царя Башану. \q Його вірна любов триває вічно.

decisions.choice: Og, king of Bashan
decisions.reason: Bashan was the high, fertile land east of the Sea of Galilee. Og came out against Israel and was defeated (Numbers 21:33-35).

decisions.choice: He killed
decisions.reason: As in verse 19.

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.

source.text: וְנָתַ֣ן אַרְצָ֣ם לְנַחֲלָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: and he gave their land as an inheritance, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave their land as an inheritance, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave their land away as a heritage, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: He gave their land to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people to keep as their own. His faithful love lasts forever.

fr.L: et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a donné leur pays en héritage, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.
fr.B: et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a donné leur pays en héritage, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Il a donné leur pays à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, pour qu’il le garde comme son bien. Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.L: na akaitoa nchi yao kuwa urithi, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele.
sw.B: na akaitoa nchi yao kuwa urithi, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.
sw.R: Aliwapa watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} nchi yao iwe mali yao wenyewe. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.

es.L: y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} dio su tierra como heredad, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal [es] para siempre.
es.B: y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} entregó su tierra como herencia, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre.
es.R: Dio la tierra de ellos a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo para que la tuviera como suya. Su amor fiel dura para siempre.

vi.L: và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban đất của chúng làm cơ nghiệp, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời.
vi.B: và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban đất của chúng làm sản nghiệp, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.
vi.R: Ngài đã ban đất của chúng cho dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm của riêng. Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.

ko.L: 그리고 그들의 땅을 유산으로 주셨다. 참으로 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다.
ko.B: 그리고 그들의 땅을 유산으로 주셨다. 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다.
ko.R: 그분께서는 그들의 땅을 그분의 백성에게 주셔서 그들의 것이 되게 하셨다. 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다.

pt.L: e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} deu a terra deles como herança, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre.
pt.B: e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} deu a terra deles como herança, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.
pt.R: Ele deu a terra deles ao {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo, para que ficasse com ela como sua. O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.

am.L: ምድራቸውንም ርስት አድርጎ የሰጠውን፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩ ለዘላለም ነውና።
am.B: ምድራቸውንም ርስት አድርጎ ሰጠ፤ ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።
am.R: ምድራቸውንም የራሳቸው አድርገው እንዲይዙ ለሕዝቡ ሰጣቸው። ጽኑ ፍቅሩም ለዘላለም ይኖራል።

hi.L: और उन्होंने उनका देश निज भाग [करके] दे दिया, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा का [है]।
hi.B: और उन्होंने उनका देश निज भाग के रूप में दे दिया, \q क्योंकि उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।
hi.R: उन्होंने उनका देश अपनी प्रजा को दे दिया, कि वह सदा उनका अपना रहे। \q उनका अटल प्रेम सदा बना रहता है।

ru.L: и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} отдал землю их в наследие, \q потому что вовек неизменная любовь {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} отдал их землю в наследие; \q {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} неизменная любовь длится вечно.
ru.R: Он отдал их землю своему народу во владение навсегда. \q Его неизменная любовь длится вечно.

ja.L: そして、彼らの地を嗣業としてお与えになった。 \q その誠実はとこしえに[続く]からである。
ja.B: そして、彼らの土地を嗣業としてお与えになった。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみはとこしえに続く。
ja.R: その方は、その土地を、ご自分の民に、ずっと自分たちのものとするように与えてくださった。 \q その変わらぬいつくしみは、いつまでも続く。

uk.L: і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} дав їхню землю як спадщину, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов — навіки.
uk.B: і {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} віддав їхню землю у спадщину, \q бо {{deity_pronoun:його|Його}} незмінна любов триває навіки.
uk.R: Він віддав їхню землю своєму народові, щоб вона була їхньою назавжди. \q Його вірна любов триває вічно.

decisions.choice: inheritance: land held by a family for good
decisions.reason: As in 135:12, land that belongs to a family and passes from parents to children.

decisions.choice: to keep as their own
decisions.reason: As in 135:12. Readable names the people, who are named in verse 22.

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.

decisions.choice: "निज भाग" (L, B); "कि वह सदा उनका अपना रहे" (R)
decisions.reason: As in 135:12, whose wording these verses repeat.
